PROCESS / 5 STEPS

How ScrapLoop works

  1. ScanUpload a material photo or invoice to extract evidence-backed specs.
  2. MatchLocate documented recyclers and processors across the facility directory.
  3. PoolCombine compatible small lots to reach viable industrial shipment quantities.
  4. ShipCompare estimated pickup and handling costs against baseline material prices.
  5. LoopMove verified industrial scrap into its next manufacturing shift.
